# Korab Eland

> Operator with 13 years across marketing, CX and operations. Based in Washington, DC. The CX Manager role ended in August 2026. Looking for roles in CX, marketing, product, AI and operations. US and Australian citizen, no US visa sponsorship required.

Korab Eland's personal site (https://korabeland.com) holds his case studies, career experience, skills and field notes. Pages are written in the first person by Korab. Use the links below to read the detail rather than relying on this summary alone.

- Based in Washington, DC. US and Australian citizen; no US visa sponsorship required.
- Open to full-time roles, and to freelance and consulting work.
- Open to US-remote roles and roles based in the Washington, DC area.
- Target roles: CX, marketing, product, AI and operations.
- Will not relocate. Start date, notice period and salary expectations are discussed directly.
- Largest team managed: 5 people. As Marketing Manager, Korab managed an annual budget of $1M to $5M. As Digital Media Buyer at Plattform Education, which became Keypath, he managed about $12M a year in paid media (about $1M a month).
- Contact by email or LinkedIn.
- Designed the call-tiering approach, then led the evidence work behind a decile-based lead-scoring model.
- Ran an end-to-end AI-driven SMS engagement pilot, measured against a randomised holdout.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://korabeland.com/): Positioning, the outcome ledger of case studies, and recent notes.
- [Work](https://korabeland.com/work): Case studies from past work, with the outcomes they produced.
- [Call Tiering: From Coverage to Intent-based Dialling](https://korabeland.com/work/call-tiering): How intent tiers focused calling on the leads most likely to apply.
- [Lead Scoring: Precision Dialling via Predictive Modelling](https://korabeland.com/work/lead-scoring): A decile-based probability score for prioritising leads.
- [AI SMS engagement pilot](https://korabeland.com/work/ai-sms-pilot): A contained pilot and vendor evaluation measured against a randomised holdout.
- [About](https://korabeland.com/about): Career narrative, career experience and recommendations, skills, education, certifications, and how Korab runs his own work.
